notes: Frame the deck as a shift from statewide success to district-specific constraints. Point to commercial strength first, then say the next income gains come from fixing water, productivity, and market-system gaps. Expect the question: why Gujarat now if it already leads on many crops?
title: Gujarat’s agriculture pairs national-scale commercial strength with water and execution gaps that now constrain farmer income growth
subtitle: Data-driven strategy deck for the Gates Foundation showing how Gujarat’s crop leadership, irrigation base, and market orientation still leave district-level water, productivity, and value-chain gaps that require targeted action
